rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 3 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 340, ENTITLED `AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A UNIFORM RETIREMENT SYSTEM FOR THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES, TO PROVIDE FOR SEPARATION THEREFROM, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES,' AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Section 3 of RA 340 states that the Widows of the deceased AFP officers or enlisted men, whose marriages were contracted after the retirement of said personnel, are DISQUALIFIED as beneficiaries. > This bill seeks to AMEND this provision.
